info.name: Performance Medicine
info.description: Performance Medicine is a multidisciplinary health clinic based in Melbourne and Sydney, specialising in the intersection of performing arts and sports science. With a team of expert physiotherapists, vocal health specialists, and performance coaches, the clinic provides evidence-based treatments tailored for performing artists, athletes, and anyone striving for optimal physical performance. Services include physiotherapy, vocal therapy, massage, rehabilitation, and performance coaching all delivered with a focus on innovation, collaboration, and long-term wellness.
